formalRules.summary: The main vowel may umlaut in VOLL, WAR, numerous §4.4 two-form contractions and §4.5 Komma-Kürzungen.
Punkt 5 ⠐ functions as the Umlautungspunkt in the §4.6 transformation grammar.
For VOLL, WAR and applicable §4.4 two-form contractions, the umlauted stem uses the same base contraction prefixed by Punkt 5.
For applicable §4.5 Komma-Kürzungen, umlauting replaces integral Punkt 2 with Punkt 5.
Umlautkürzungen not present in the §4.6 whitelist are not permitted.
Punkt 5 occurring in the Lautgruppenkürzungen ATION, ATIV, ISMUS, ISTISCH and ITÄT is explicitly not an Umlautungspunkt.

lassLaessResolution.note: Section 4.6 does not list the complete word LÄSST; it normatively defines the LÄSS umlauted contraction stem.
